label: Q1 单只股票完整K线(选股详情页)
sql: SELECT trade_date,open,high,low,close,volume,pct_change FROM market.daily_bar WHERE symbol='688610.SH' ORDER BY trade_date

label: Q2 单只股票近期窗口
sql: SELECT trade_date,close,turnover_rate FROM market.daily_bar WHERE symbol='688610.SH' AND trade_date>='2026-01-01'

label: Q3 全市场某日快照(因子横截面)
sql: SELECT symbol,close,pct_change,turnover_rate FROM market.daily_bar WHERE trade_date='2026-10-19'

label: Q4 近20日全市场(因子计算主查询)
Q5 质量过滤(选股前置)
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM market.daily_bar WHERE quality_status='ok' AND trade_date>='2026-10-01'

label: Q6 raw 单只股票落地审计
sql: SELECT source_name,adjust_type,trade_date,close FROM raw.daily_bar WHERE symbol='688610.SH'

label: Q7 raw 按source核对
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM raw.daily_bar WHERE source_name='hithink_finance_dump' AND trade_date='2026-10-19'

label: Q8 复权因子单只
sql: SELECT trade_date,factor FROM market.adjustment_factor WHERE symbol='688610.SH' AND adjust_type='qfq' ORDER BY trade_date

label: Q9 因子值按日期取(API分页)
sql: SELECT factor_name,symbol,value FROM factor.factor_value WHERE trade_date='2026-10-19' LIMIT 100

label: Q10 行业/日期范围聚合
sql: SELECT symbol,count(*) FROM market.daily_bar WHERE trade_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-10-19' GROUP BY symbol LIMIT 50
